details.fvg_pairing: For each qualifying second FVG, pair it with the most recent qualifying opposite-direction FVG inside the candidate maximum age. If more than one FVG has the same formation second, use the one with the largest overlap, then lexical event id.
details.external_liquidity_freeze: The prior high and low are computed over the candidate lookback ending immediately before the 30-second sweep window. The sweep and target therefore cannot change after the second FVG forms.
details.retest: The first completed actual-trade one-second bar touching BPR consequent encroachment and closing on the second-displacement side with registered directional flow is the only retest. If the structural stop or frozen target is touched first, the setup is invalid.
details.entry_missing_second: If the immediately following UTC second has no actual trade, the setup is unavailable rather than filled at a later favorable print.
details.trade_return: Gross return is direction times exit-minus-entry divided by entry. Each cost profile subtracts its full round-trip basis-point charge once.
details.unresolved_source_boundary: Record a structural-stop exit at the frozen stop price and charge the full cost profile.
details.global_slot: Route raw trades in causal entry-time order across BTC and ETH. Same-time candidates use larger displacement z, larger BPR overlap and lexical trade id. A new entry is allowed only strictly after the prior exit timestamp.
details.top_winner_removal: Identify the largest ceiling(10 percent) positive 12bp trades from the initial global route by trade id, exclude those ids from the raw candidate trade set, and rerun global-slot routing from the beginning.
details.fit_selection_ties: Use 24bp mean, 12bp counterfactual total return, positive symbol-date count and candidate id in that order.
